# Maxfuse

## Stage control

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `bool` | `True` | `basic` | Run the MaxFuse cross-modality matching stage. | - |

## Inputs

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reference_name` | `str` | `atlas` | `basic` | Stable short name used to prefix transferred reference annotations. | - |
| `reference_adata_path` | `str` | `maxfuse/reference.h5ad` | `basic` | Project-relative AnnData path for the single scRNA-seq reference. | Exactly one reference is supported per execution. |
| `target_adata_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional target IMC AnnData path; defaults to general.anndata_path. | - |
| `feature_mapping_path` | `str` | `maxfuse/feature_mapping.csv` | `basic` | CSV mapping measured target features to linked reference genes. | - |
| `reference_layer` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional reference AnnData layer used for matching, expression plots, and DEGs. | - |
| `target_layer` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional target AnnData layer used for matching. | - |

## Reusable outputs

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_folder` | `str` | `maxfuse_results` | `basic` | Canonical project-relative folder for reusable MaxFuse result assets. | Execution figures and diagnostic tables are stored separately in the managed report. |
| `write_matched_transcriptomes` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Write an optional target-indexed matched-transcriptome AnnData asset. | This can be very large because repeated reference matches are materialized. |
| `matched_transcriptome_min_score` | `float` | `0.85` | `advanced` | Score threshold for the optional matched-transcriptome asset. | - |

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |

| `mapping_filter_column` | `Optional[str]` | `All` | `advanced` | Optional mapping column whose truthy rows are eligible for matching. | - |

## Labels

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reference_smoothing_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `annotation_level_3` | `basic` | Reference observation labels used only for within-modality centroid shrinkage. | - |
| `target_smoothing_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Target observation labels used for centroid shrinkage; defaults to target_population_obs. | - |

| `reference_transfer_obs` | `List[str]` | `['annotation_level_3', 'annotation_level_4']` | `basic` | Reference observation columns transferred to matched target cells. | - |
| `reference_label_roles` | `Dict[str, Literal['lineage', 'subtype', 'state', 'other']]` | `{}` | `advanced` | Optional biological roles for transferred reference label columns. | - |
| `sample_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional target sample column for coverage diagnostics; defaults to general.case_obs. | - |
| `roi_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional target ROI column for coverage diagnostics; defaults to general.roi_obs. | - |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reference_active_features` | `int` | `1000` | `basic` | Maximum number of reference active features used during refinement. | - |
